The main takeaway from our work is that
pessimism is a fundamental issue with unsupervised skill learning, and we provide a simple solution that is applicable to any latent-conditioned trajectory objective.
the pessimism inherent to skill learning objectives is not necessarily a bad thing, but it can be harnessed to provide a useful exploration bonus.

we should be careful when designing intrinsic rewards for exploration: the reward should be designed to encourage the agent towards its true objective, not towards some proxy objective that is easier to optimize.
